## About
Kash Auto Parts & Salvage, also known as Kash's Auto Wrecking, sits on Woodland Ave in Cleveland and serves the area with quality used parts.
Neighbors come to us when something breaks and they need it fixed without a fuss. One reviewer saved a car after a tree fell on it with a fender from us. Another got a vandalized truck window replaced and was back on the road before noon.
We hold a 4.2 rating from 425 Google reviews. Give us a call and tell us what you're looking for.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for your car or truck. One reviewer found the fender they needed in great shape.
- Car windows: We can put a new window in your car. One reviewer said the work was fast and reasonably priced.
- Battery: A reviewer has come back to us twice for a battery and said the first one lasted until it was time to change it.
